findings.observed: Original unity generator appends to the prior output. First compilation succeeds; regeneration creates four includes from two inputs and compilation fails with redefinitions. The maintained replacement prototype compiles with two includes and handles an explicit configured source removal.

Original loop returns zero after a required first child fails and later children succeed. The maintained prerequisite graph returns nonzero and does not run its dependent app; the all-successful graph passes with two parallel jobs.
Reviewed GNU Make 4.3 rejects --profile=profile.log. Its supported --trace command succeeds and emits update decisions; no duration profiler or speed improvement is inferred.

other_dispositions: The illustrative 100-file timing table has no raw measurements, project identity, host or repeated-run provenance in this resource. Its speedup numbers are not admitted as measured evidence; this does not prove those numbers false.
Parallelism and built-in compiler-default issues were previously reviewed; their prior records are retained rather than counted as new discoveries.
Version, POSIX, cache, distributed-build, PCH and LTO claims are not independently qualified by the current controls. No availability or performance claim is inferred from reading them.
